title: Recurrent - Why We're Excited about LFP Batteries for Electric Cars
notes: Published 2024-05-31. Reviewers in cold climates report LFP Model 3 winter range loss a few percentage points above NCA Model 3s (qualitative, no measured %); LFP fast charges poorly below -20 °C. B116: no range penalty for LFP (mixed evidence), a cold-charging note instead.
